messages.subject: Aymeric | Industrial & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Aymeric,

Your leadership within Kestria France and its executive-search coverage across industrial, energy, natural-resources and infrastructure sectors makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where operating performance depends on institutional relationships, ESG and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition in a regulated operating environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, mining, energy and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to France, wider Europe, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria France-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
